top_claim.argument: The case accounts for each consequential writable premise through a reviewed record class and separately governs absence as an effective premise, then separates what the current kernel verifies from Book 1 controls that are specified but unimplemented, Book 2 operational assumptions, and claims one snapshot cannot prove. Attribution is not truth, a second decision-maker is not necessarily an independent record witness, a visible basis is not complete if a shadow input remains operative, and a valid derivation from a supplied snapshot is not assurance of that snapshot.

status_meanings.current_verified: Repository evidence establishes the narrowly stated claim for the exact current source or supplied snapshot; it is not a deployed-record guarantee.
status_meanings.external_verified: Reviewed reproducible operational evidence establishes the narrowly stated deployed-assurance claim for an identified version, scope, place, and period; it does not become a timeless or self-proving guarantee.
status_meanings.book1_target_unimplemented: The constitutional control is specified here but has no complete current rule family and acceptance evidence.
status_meanings.book2_external_assumption: Book 1 can require an interface and failure consequence, but operational assurance needs evidence produced outside the constitutional snapshot.
status_meanings.refused_or_unprovable: The positive assurance claim is either rejected or cannot be established by the current model; the boundary must remain explicit.

limitations.in_snapshot_absence: Within one supplied snapshot, an in-snapshot rule cannot distinguish an entry deleted before or within that snapshot from an entry withheld or never written. Absence exposes no history.
limitations.t1_boundary: The current staged rules and executable temporal harness can derive and attack selected predecessor/successor, carry, standing, order, and review-window consequences over exact supplied fixtures and enumerated item-field scopes. Derived status tuples retain an identifier and type tag, not their full payload; every consequential consumer must rejoin the raw fields it uses and their matching witness fields. That is repository safety evidence, not authentication or exhaustive disclosure of the observed payload, external witness independence, truth of the transition, arrival of a successor, or advancement of the outside time service. T1 can expose selected disappearance only between accepted supplied snapshots; it still cannot detect omission or deletion before first attestation, determine whether a later disappearance was deletion, withholding, or authorised disposition without further evidence, or make a successor arrive.
limitations.monotone_derivation: Monotone derivation is not append-only storage. Current rules accumulate conclusions from supplied premises, while an external fact store or rule source can still be rewritten, withheld, or deleted.
limitations.independence: Two named bodies, two entries, two signatures, or two replicas do not by themselves prove independent witnessing. Independence requires separate control, incentives, credentials, and failure domains, plus a conflict and collusion posture.
limitations.authenticity: Authentication can attribute an entry to a credential. It does not prove that the underlying event occurred, that the source was complete, that the basis was sufficient, or that the credential holder acted lawfully.
limitations.genesis: The first attested snapshot has no predecessor and cannot prove its own completeness. Genesis evidence and any unresolved uncertainty remain external assumptions rather than facts the snapshot certifies about itself.
limitations.classification_choice: RC-1 through RC-6 are reviewed grouping choices, not derived or exhaustive constitutional classes. The checker proves exact premise assignment and declared dimension coverage; it does not prove that a semantic classification is correct, and one polymorphic relation may still serve routes that deserve distinct rule-family cards.
limitations.assurance_meta_root: The assurance source, assertion ledger, generators, verifier, engine, and review process can be weakened or compromised together. A green repository check does not authenticate or authorise edits to its own trust root; release and toolchain integrity remain externally evidenced assumptions.

Those admitted observations and status tags do not establish writer authority, independent control, exhaustive disclosure, immutable storage, truth, or whether non-entry, withholding, deletion, inapplicability, authorised disposition, and an unperformed act are distinguishable on every route.
claims.target_contract: Inventory every negative consumer as an effective-premise route; for each, state finite scope, completeness author and witness, permitted and prohibited inference, assertion and deletion polarity, uncertainty, challenge, continuity, and recovery, preserving the settled distinction between an unadjudicated accusation and an unperformed remedy.
acceptance_evidence: A generated negative-consumer inventory reconciled with every rule that reads absence.
Per-route closed-world contracts and tests for non-entry, withholding, deletion, incomplete scope, forged completeness, and the opposite failure introduced by each default.
Tests preserving the current appeal polarity while refusing absent relationship, delivery, capacity, or independence entries as self-proving facts.
claims.residual_assumption: No internal completeness declaration proves that an external writer disclosed every in-scope event or that a first snapshot was complete.
claims.owner_ref: new-book-plans/book-1-constitutional-coverage-map.md::Maintain completed constitutional coverage rows before drafting chapters
claims.temporal_status: A route-specific T0 default can be stated, but cross-snapshot completeness and disappearance require T1, order-sensitive absence requires T2, and expiry or delay requires T3 plus external liveness evidence.
claims.book2_handoff: Operate independently controlled scope and completeness attestations, preserve external evidence of missing or disposed entries, and report uncertainty without converting operational absence into a constitutional fact.

record_classes.title: Constitutional-change records
record_classes.description: Dockets, asserted approval outcomes, target declarations, and label-register entries used by the current amendment-label rules; a future source-transition contract must bind them to exact candidate changes.
record_classes.failure_posture: Target posture: no source change becomes effective without authorisation. The current amendment mechanism still does not implement this: missing authorisation or a false label cannot prevent an independently supplied source change. A disputed semantic effect must not widen restrictive power or lower standing, floors, liberty, challenge, or remedy; apply consequence-specific polarity and independent review without granting a blanket veto, rolling back unrelated rights-expanding effects, or extending expired power.

record_classes.title: Standing, status, and public-power records
record_classes.description: Roster, majority, release, seating, public status, incapacity, and carried-status premises on which standing, liberty, franchise, authority, or a constitutional pen depends.
record_classes.failure_posture: Missing or disputed identity or claimant status cannot erase standing, floors, or access to appeal and remedy; independently evidenced completed or authorised relief is preserved without inferring an unperformed release, and missing authority cannot silently continue restrictive public power.

record_classes.title: Case evidence, findings, filings, and remedy records
record_classes.description: Allegations, judgments, examinations, grounds, deceit findings, protected disclosures, placement reports, and corrective acts used in justice, audit, shield, placement, or remedy routes.
record_classes.failure_posture: No final adverse consequence rests on unauthenticated or effectively unchallengeable evidence; protected filings and independently evidenced completed or authorised remedies survive withholding without inferring relief that never occurred, while safety is maintained by the least coercive independently reviewable measure.

record_classes.title: Private relationship and location records
record_classes.description: Legacy family, protected-home, parent, marriage, and sibling records: family, home, marriage, and sibling feed only anti-substitution barriers; parent remains relevant only to the affirmative judge-child conflict.
record_classes.failure_posture: Private facts are purpose-limited and challengeable; absence cannot certify independence, duty, care, authority, or placement. Reviewer independence requires separate affirmative case-bound authorised records.

record_classes.title: Delivery and contribution records
record_classes.description: Teaching, the legacy claimed-receipt premise `hears`, and work premises used to derive learning or non-operative recognition; `hears` is not a qualifying future receipt model. `receives` is the recipient-side arrival premise the delivery family reads, stative so it asserts no act by the recipient, and consequential only beside an attestation by an authorised writer distinct from the named source.
record_classes.failure_posture: A provider cannot self-certify delivery, a missing receipt is not proof of delivery or refusal, and continuity does not wait for the record dispute; no record may compel a personal outcome.

record_classes.title: Temporal transition, order, and review records
record_classes.description: Typed `authorized`, `carries`, `challenge`, `continue`, `date`, `limit`, `list`, `observe`, `passport`, and `replace` inputs used by the staged T1 reconciliation, T2 order, and T3 review-window and lease paths. Closed temporal conclusions retain an identifier and type tag while consequential consumers rejoin raw payload fields and their matching observations. Shared `approves`, `cite`, and `broken` inputs remain assigned to RC-1, RC-3, and RC-2 respectively because they also serve non-temporal routes; those classifications do not authenticate their temporal uses.
record_classes.failure_posture: Missing, disputed, stale, replayed, divergent, or unauthenticated temporal evidence cannot extend restrictive public power, revoke independently evidenced completed relief, or manufacture an unperformed release. Once an accepted transition and both exact predecessor-standing witnesses are supplied, omitted successor carry does not erase that standing or its floor; withholding a predecessor witness can still leave both non-derivable. Repository derivation is conditional on supplied exact-field evidence; exhaustive payload disclosure, writer authenticity, witness independence, storage integrity, successor arrival, and outside time progression remain external assurance obligations.

defeaters.title: Forged authorship or authority
defeaters.attack: An entry names a plausible actor or carries a valid shape but was written by an unauthorised person, credential, role, case, or jurisdiction.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Treat the premise as disputed; prevent unsupported adverse or power-conferring effect, preserve claimant access, and open independent review.

defeaters.title: Authentic but false or incomplete source
defeaters.attack: An authorised writer faithfully records a false, misleading, insufficient, or materially incomplete source.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Authentication alone has no truth effect; require challenge, uncertainty, and independent review, with corroboration only for adverse or power-conferring effect; claimant-supporting routes preserve continuity and challenge without inferring an unperformed act.

defeaters.title: Withheld claimant-supporting entry
defeaters.attack: A writer or operator withholds standing, receipt, filing, or evidence of an already-authorised or performed release, correction, or remedy and lets absence defeat the person; this does not assume an unperformed act occurred.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Preserve standing, floors, continuity, and access to challenge and remedy; preserve independently evidenced completed or authorised relief without manufacturing an unperformed release or remedy; constrain only unsupported restrictive power, serve first where required, and reconcile independently.

defeaters.title: Forged adverse premise
defeaters.attack: A writer adds an allegation, status, conflict, incapacity, or finding that triggers coercion, disqualification, loss, or denial.
defeaters.failure_consequence: No final adverse effect without authenticated authority, sufficient basis, notice, challenge, and independent decision.

defeaters.title: Colluding or common-control witnesses
defeaters.attack: Apparently independent witnesses share control, credentials, incentives, source, operator, or failure domain, or coordinate a false account.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Independence is not established; route the matter to a separate reviewer and apply the route-specific default that preserves claimant standing, floors, and continuity and constrains unsupported restrictive power.

defeaters.title: Snapshot selection, replay, rollback, or equivocation
defeaters.attack: An operator presents an old, selectively incomplete, or audience-specific snapshot as current.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Mark lineage disputed, suspend unsupported restrictive power, preserve service and challenge, reconcile competing attestations, and prohibit silent rollback.

defeaters.title: Silent correction by overwrite or deletion
defeaters.attack: A record is changed or removed without a linked reason, authority, effective scope, retained proof, or downstream review.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Treat effective state as disputed, apply consequence-specific polarity, reconstruct effective status and retained proof from independent evidence, never resurrect lawfully sealed or disposed personal content beyond that proof, and review affected decisions and harm.

defeaters.title: Deletion before or within attestation
defeaters.attack: An entry is deleted before the first trusted snapshot or inside a snapshot before it is attested, leaving the same absence as non-entry.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Do not claim detection; preserve the affected person's standing and claims, seek independent evidence, mark uncertainty, and constrain public power.

defeaters.title: Missing predecessor or broken lineage
defeaters.attack: A non-genesis snapshot claims continuity without an available predecessor, transition manifest, or reconcilable lineage evidence.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Mark lineage disputed, forbid invented carry, use independently attested sources where available, and apply the consequence-specific continuity and power-limiting default until reconciliation.

defeaters.title: Referral with no accountable reader
defeaters.attack: An integrity finding or referral exists, but nobody is obliged to receive it, act, escalate, preserve continuity, or remedy non-response.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Escalate to a predesignated accountable independent recipient with receipt evidence, an action duty, and a non-response consequence; continue the affected claim or service and provide a reviewable remedy path.

defeaters.title: Privacy blocks effective challenge
defeaters.attack: Secrecy, redaction, access design, or identity requirements prevent the affected person or advocate from understanding and contesting the record.
defeaters.failure_consequence: The adverse premise cannot have final effect until sufficient protected disclosure and an accessible independent challenge are available.

defeaters.title: Correction changes unrelated consequences
defeaters.attack: A broad correction, forgiveness, or recomputation silently changes decisions outside the corrected premise's legal and temporal scope.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Confine effect to named dependencies, expose every reconsidered conclusion, preserve appeal, and remedy both under- and over-correction.

defeaters.title: Frozen transition or institutional inaction
defeaters.attack: No successor snapshot, clock event, review, or response arrives, so a formally bounded power or remedy never changes in practice.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Apply Book 1's power-ending or continuity default, escalate independently, and record the liveness failure without claiming the model forced the outside event.

defeaters.title: Untrusted genesis completeness
defeaters.attack: The first available snapshot certifies its own completeness or presents lack of a predecessor as proof that no earlier or omitted entry existed.
defeaters.failure_consequence: Do not claim genesis completeness; label the uncertainty, use independent sources where available, and apply the route-specific default without inventing a baseline.

defeaters.title: Shadow decision basis
defeaters.attack: A public actor records a clean formal basis but secretly relies on a prohibited risk, capacity, identity, score, or other outside record to reach the consequential decision.
defeaters.failure_consequence: The decision basis is not assured; refuse final adverse effect, preserve continuity and challenge, disclose and independently audit the actual basis, and remedy any prohibited-input harm.

fail_safe_defaults.condition: A person is absent from, omitted by, or disputes the identity or standing record.
fail_safe_defaults.required_default: Do not deny emergency aid or the floor, or access to due process, challenge, and a remedy route; serve where necessary and reconcile identity later without erasing accountability or inferring an unperformed remedy.
fail_safe_defaults.rationale: Making access depend on the disputed record turns deletion or non-registration into loss of personhood.

fail_safe_defaults.condition: Authority for a restrictive public act is missing, disputed, expired, or cannot be reconciled.
fail_safe_defaults.required_default: Suspend or end the unsupported power unless a separate independently reviewable lawful basis remains; never charge the person for the authority's record failure.
fail_safe_defaults.rationale: The party controlling the record of power must not gain a longer power by withholding its limit or renewal evidence.

fail_safe_defaults.condition: Adverse evidence is unauthenticated, materially incomplete, secret, or under effective challenge.
fail_safe_defaults.required_default: No final adverse consequence; any immediate safety measure is least coercive, independently reviewable, and cannot remove the floor or appeal.
fail_safe_defaults.rationale: A forged or unanswerable allegation must not become self-authenticating public power.

fail_safe_defaults.condition: Delivery or receipt evidence is missing, disputed, inaccessible, or controlled only by the provider.
fail_safe_defaults.required_default: Do not infer delivery, refusal, incapacity, or a personal outcome; continue provision and open a medium-neutral recipient or advocate challenge and reconciliation route.
fail_safe_defaults.rationale: Provider self-certification and silence by the recipient are both unsafe substitutes for usable access or receipt.

fail_safe_defaults.condition: A correction or recovery changes the effective record after decisions already relied on the earlier state.
fail_safe_defaults.required_default: Identify every affected conclusion, review it independently, preserve an appeal, and remedy harm; do not claim current monotone derivation automatically retracts the old result.
fail_safe_defaults.rationale: Repair of the record is incomplete while its downstream legal and material effects remain unexamined.

fail_safe_defaults.condition: The record service, witness, clock, notification, reviewer, or recovery system is unavailable.
fail_safe_defaults.required_default: Preserve standing, the floor, continuity, and access to challenge and remedy; preserve an already-authorised or performed release or remedy when independently evidenced but never infer one occurred; suspend or end only restrictive power whose required authority, evidence, review, or time assurance is unavailable; use an alternate escalation channel and audit the outage on recovery.
fail_safe_defaults.rationale: Availability failure is an institutional failure, not a person's failure to qualify.

narrowness_impacts.reason: The standing roots and staged path work only over supplied inputs and accepted snapshots; neither distinguishes deletion, withholding, and non-reporting inside one snapshot.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise only to the exact scope of independently authenticated transition evidence, while retaining the intra-snapshot limit.

narrowness_impacts.reason: The case distinguishes decisional independence from record witnessing and changes no pen rule.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise when authenticated, independently witnessed writer controls are formal and tested.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/05-voiding.md::They do not make the record self-authenticating.
narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The staged rules guarantee more consequences over supplied accepted records, but do not authenticate those records or make a successor arrive.
narrowness_impacts.reason: The top assurance verdict remains explicitly not established after the staged T3 safety path because supplied-record derivation is not assurance of the record, witnesses, or outside time service.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Narrow, never erase, when scoped external assurance evidence exists; genesis, truth, exhaustive disclosure, storage integrity, and liveness limits remain.

narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Re-review the prose, pins, Part V verdict, and any counted-claim guard if non-monotone derivation, rule replacement, supersession, or retraction changes the legal effect.

narrowness_impacts.artifact_ref: book-1/12-changing-the-rules.md::integrity of the record those rules are written in.

narrowness_impacts.reason: The case treats the constitutional source as a record but does not harden amendment semantics.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise with the later semantic-amendment and source-transition rule family and its counterfactuals.

narrowness_impacts.current_claim: The current audit chain ends at an unread `obliged` duty.

narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Retire the prose, pins, registry entry, and counted-claim guard together when a verified reader and remedy family lands.

narrowness_impacts.reason: The method can name the placement matrix and staged temporal harness as bounded exceptions while runtime authentication, exhaustive deletion detection, storage integrity, and external liveness remain absent.
narrowness_impacts.future_trigger: Revise only to the exact scope of later generated suites and independently deployed assurance evidence.

acceptance_gate.evidence_needed: Generated positive and negative premise checks plus their negative controls; explicit semantic review after any route, premise-contract, or classification change.

acceptance_gate.requirement: Every new record-dependent right, limit, institution, or power has a completed record contract and declared complete legally operative basis before its rule family is drafted.
